name: nats-server
description: Self-hosted NATS pub/sub server on Fly.io (WebSocket, scoped JWT auth via @nats-io operator/account chain)
instructions: Add FLY_API_TOKEN to packages/infra/environments/<env>/secrets.yaml. NATS_OPERATOR_SEED and NATS_ACCOUNT_SEED are the root of the NATS decentralized auth chain — if you don't have them yet, run apply once and the module will generate a pair and print them; paste both into secrets.yaml and re-run. The module creates a Fly Machine running nats:latest with WebSocket on wss://<appName>.fly.dev and verifies JWTs locally (no network callbacks).
